arguments: At x=c, |x-c| has opposite left/right slopes; elsewhere its local affine branch supplies differentiability. Translation and absolute-value convexity give convexity.

For effective normal a=y*z, max(1-<a,x>,0) is a maximum of two affine functions. If a=0 it is constant 1. If a!=0, x0=a/||a||^2 satisfies <a,x0>=1; along x0+t*a the loss is max(-t*||a||^2,0), whose left and right slopes differ. Away from this hyperplane one strict branch persists locally.
At a margin point, a tangent direction v with <a,v>=0 yields the constant-zero restriction. Hence the ambient non-differentiability claim does not prohibit tangent derivatives.
Over R, y*z=0 iff y=0 or z=0. Zero-dimensional carriers force z=0.
independentQualification.source_invalid_scope: The universal interpretation that every parameterized hinge is not everywhere differentiable is refuted by y=0 or z=0. The source paragraph is motivational prose with unspecified quantification, so do not upgrade this to a blanket author-error/SOURCE_INVALID verdict.

statements.name: shifted_absolute_convex_differentiable_iff
statements.signature:
theorem shifted_absolute_convex_differentiable_iff (c : ℝ) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun x : ℝ => |x - c|) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ => |w - c|) x ↔ x ≠ c

statements.name: hinge_convex_differentiable_iff
statements.signature:
theorem hinge_convex_differentiable_iff {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (a : E) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun x : E => max (1 - inner ℝ a x) 0) ∧
      ∀ x : E, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : E => max (1 - inner ℝ a w) 0) x ↔
        inner ℝ a x ≠ 1

statements.name: labelled_hinge_convex_differentiable_iff
statements.signature:
theorem labelled_hinge_convex_differentiable_iff {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] (y : ℝ) (z : E) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun x : E => max (1 - y * inner ℝ z x) 0) ∧
      (∀ x : E, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : E => max (1 - y * inner ℝ z w) 0) x ↔
        y * inner ℝ z x ≠ 1) ∧
      (Differentiable ℝ (fun w : E => max (1 - y * inner ℝ z w) 0) ↔ y • z = 0)

statements.name: positive_negative_labels
statements.signature:
theorem positive_negative_labels :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun w : ℝ => max (1 - 2 * inner ℝ (3 : ℝ) w) 0) ∧
      ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun w : ℝ => max (1 - (-2) * inner ℝ (3 : ℝ) w) 0) ∧
      ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ => max (1 - 2 * inner ℝ (3 : ℝ) w) 0) (1 / 6) ∧
      ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ => max (1 - (-2) * inner ℝ (3 : ℝ) w) 0) (-1 / 6) ∧
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ => max (1 - 2 * inner ℝ (3 : ℝ) w) 0) 0 ∧
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : ℝ => max (1 - (-2) * inner ℝ (3 : ℝ) w) 0) 0 ∧
      ¬ Differentiable ℝ (fun w : ℝ => max (1 - 2 * inner ℝ (3 : ℝ) w) 0) ∧
      ¬ Differentiable ℝ (fun w : ℝ => max (1 - (-2) * inner ℝ (3 : ℝ) w) 0)

statements.name: zero_label_and_feature
statements.signature:
theorem zero_label_and_feature (y z : ℝ) :
    Differentiable ℝ (fun w : ℝ => max (1 - 0 * inner ℝ z w) 0) ∧
      Differentiable ℝ (fun w : ℝ => max (1 - y * inner ℝ (0 : ℝ) w) 0) ∧
      ∀ w : ℝ, max (1 - 0 * inner ℝ z w) 0 = 1 ∧
        max (1 - y * inner ℝ (0 : ℝ) w) 0 = 1

theorem plane_ambient_and_tangential :
    ¬ DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : Plane => max (1 - inner ℝ e0 w) 0)
        (e0 + (3 : ℝ) • e1) ∧
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w : Plane => max (1 - inner ℝ e0 w) 0) e1 ∧
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun t : ℝ => max (1 - inner ℝ e0 (e0 + (3 + t) • e1)) 0) 0

theorem dimension_zero (y : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 0)) :
    Differentiable ℝ
        (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 0) => max (1 - y * inner ℝ z w) 0) ∧
      ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 0), max (1 - y * inner ℝ z w) 0 = 1
